description: Down Bad is me after any situationship, the 'down bad crying at the gym' line is my literal whole personality 😭💅 The whole TTPD era is mother processing her breakup and this song is the peak of it. It's so dramatic and I am HERE for the lore of it all. 'Fuck it if I can't have him'?? I felt that in my bones. A banger and a cry at the same time, genius ✨🔥
